mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_questions ( event_id, question_type, title, description, is_required, sort_order, rating_min, rating_max ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{questionType}, #{title}, #{description}, #{required}, #{sortOrder}, #{ratingMin}, #{ratingMax} )
INSERT INTO question_options ( question_id, option_text, sort_order, is_other ) VALUES ( #{questionId}, #{optionText}, #{sortOrder}, #{isOther} )
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) + 1 FROM event_questions WHERE event_id = #{eventId}

SELECT id, event_id AS eventId, question_type AS questionType, title, description, is_required AS required, sort_order AS sortOrder, rating_min AS ratingMin, rating_max AS ratingMax, created_at AS createdAt FROM event_questions WHERE id = #{questionId}
SELECT id, question_id AS questionId, option_text AS optionText, sort_order AS sortOrder, is_other AS isOther FROM question_options WHERE question_id = #{questionId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, event_id AS eventId, question_type AS questionType, title, description, is_required AS required, sort_order AS sortOrder, rating_min AS ratingMin, rating_max AS ratingMax, created_at AS createdAt FROM event_questions WHERE event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT qo.id, qo.question_id AS questionId, qo.option_text AS optionText, qo.sort_order AS sortOrder, qo.is_other AS isOther FROM question_options qo INNER JOIN event_questions eq ON eq.id = qo.question_id WHERE eq.event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY eq.sort_order ASC, eq.id ASC, qo.sort_order ASC, qo.id ASC

SELECT id, event_id AS eventId, question_type AS questionType, title, description, is_required AS required, sort_order AS sortOrder, rating_min AS ratingMin, rating_max AS ratingMax, created_at AS createdAt FROM event_questions WHERE id = #{questionId} AND event_id = #{eventId}
SELECT id FROM event_questions WHERE event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answers WHERE question_id = #{questionId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answer_options WHERE question_option_id = #{optionId}
